_readme: Answer key for tests/fixtures/contrast-tiers.json. Written from the fixture, not from script output: every `basis` names the fixture values the expectation comes from. Ratios use the WCAG formula by hand: a grey v has luminance ((v + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4; on white the ratio is 1.05 / (L + 0.05), on black it is (L + 0.05) / 0.05. Token pairs carry no font size, so a pair between 3:1 and 4.5:1 is reported as large-text-only, apart from a pair below 3:1, and both count as failures of 1.4.3 for normal text.

checks.basis: Both collections are present, every variable has explicit scopes and a unique single-dash codeSyntax.WEB, both Semantic modes carry a value, all three library pages exist, and the one text style binds fontSize to font/size-16. Nothing in the fixture is an error.

Four contrast warnings and nothing else: color/text/secondary (large text only) and color/text/muted (below 3:1) on color/bg/page, each in Light and Dark. color/text/primary passes at 21:1 in both modes.
Same 3 x 1 in the Dark mode of the Semantic collection.
Every pair below 4.5:1 fails 1.4.3 for normal text: secondary 3.98 and muted 2.11 in Light, secondary 3.66 and muted 2.46 in Dark = 4.

Between 3:1 and 4.5:1: color/text/secondary in Light (gray-500, v = 0.5, L = 0.214041, on white 1.05 / 0.264041 = 3.98) and in Dark (gray-400, v = 0.4, L = 0.132868, on black 0.182868 / 0.05 = 3.66) = 2.
Below 3:1: color/text/muted in Light (gray-700, v = 0.7, L = 0.447988, on white 1.05 / 0.497988 = 2.11) and in Dark (gray-300, v = 0.3, L = 0.073239, on black 0.123239 / 0.05 = 2.46) = 2.
color/text/secondary on color/bg/page, Light, 3.98:1: a warning of its own, naming the size at which the pair is still fine.

count.message: light: "color/text/secondary" on "color/bg/page" — contrast 3.98:1 (large text only: fails WCAG AA 4.5:1 for normal text, passes 3:1 at ≥ 24px or ≥ 18.66px bold)

checks.basis: color/text/secondary on color/bg/page, Dark, 3.66:1: the same warning in the other mode.

count.message: dark: "color/text/secondary" on "color/bg/page" — contrast 3.66:1 (large text only: fails WCAG AA 4.5:1 for normal text, passes 3:1 at ≥ 24px or ≥ 18.66px bold)

checks.basis: color/text/muted on color/bg/page, Dark, 2.46:1: the below-3:1 warning keeps its existing wording.

count.message: dark: "color/text/muted" on "color/bg/page" — contrast 2.46:1 (fails WCAG AA Large 3:1)

checks.basis: The pair entry for color/text/secondary in Light: 3.98, fails 4.5:1, passes 3:1.
The pair entry for color/text/muted in Dark: 2.46, fails both bars.
color/text/primary is gray-1000 on gray-0 in Light (21:1): a passing pair stays out of worstLight.
